title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 094
review_goal: Differentiate translate, tv, and ufo variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Letter A shape under one short top bar with one crossing character stroke on the left
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants translation to read as a language symbol built from letters and character strokes.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the framed translate icon when the mark should not rely on a plus cross inside an open square frame.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot is built from a letter style language mark instead of a frame with a plus cross.

items.depicts_observation: Rectangular screen with one short center stand under the lower edge
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the television to read as a clean flat screen resting on one short stand.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the antenna television when the screen should show two prongs rising from the top edge.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot keeps the television plain with one lower stand and no top antenna prongs.

items.depicts_observation: Rectangular screen with two antenna prongs rising from the top edge
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the television to feel more like a classic set with antenna prongs on top.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the flat screen stand when the display should not have prongs growing from the top edge.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot adds the top antenna prongs that are missing from the flat screen television variant.

items.depicts_observation: Flying saucer with one round dome on top of one flat oval base
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a clean front facing saucer without tilt or beam dots below it.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the tilted ufo when the craft should angle to one side and trail small beam dots below.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot keeps the saucer upright and simple instead of tilting it and adding beam dots.

items.depicts_observation: Tilted flying saucer with one round dome and three small beam dots falling below
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the ufo to feel in motion with a tilted body and beam dots below.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the upright saucer when the craft should face front and avoid the falling beam dots.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot tilts the saucer and adds beam dots under it instead of keeping the ship flat and centered.
